dct_title_s: Damage Assessment in Wundwin Township, Meiktila District Mandalay Region, Myanmar as of 01 April 2025
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: EQ20250328MMR, GDACS ID: 1474477** This map illustrates the density of damaged buildings affected by the March 28, 2025, earthquake in Mandalay. The analysis focuses on Wundwin Township, Meiktila District, Mandalay Region, where damage was detected using a Pleiades very high-resolution satellite image acquired on April 01, 2025. Over the 270 km² of analysed area, 325 damaged structures and 672 potentially damaged. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
